# kind: # The machine form of the event catalogue (hobnix/server#145 owns the full list and the prose). A script may emit only kinds listed here
# (tests/event-log.sh); core kinds only; a package declares its own in package.toml `[[events]]` (docs/events.md). Level is the usual one: info, warn or error.

meaning (columns separated by a tab; ": a disk was seen for the first time (plugged in)
a missing disk is back
a known disk is not there any more
SMART values of a disk grew within the watch window
a missing disk was removed from the inventory on purpose
first reading of the daily SMART check for a disk
the SMART baseline of a disk was taken again
the daily SMART check rates a disk as watch
the daily SMART check rates a disk as failing
the daily SMART check rates a disk as healthy again
a job was accepted and waits
a job started
a job finished successfully
a job failed
a job was stopped on purpose
a job was running when the server restarted
a job waits for an answer to a question (subject: the job id; the payload names the question key and kind, never a label or a value)
a waiting job got its answer and runs again
a push message was delivered to a channel (subject: the channel)
a push message was held back (quiet hours)
a push message could not be delivered
a disk was plugged in (udev; subject: the kernel name)
a disk was taken out (udev; subject: the kernel name)
an old disk-events line with a label that is not known (import only)

an app was paused because of a storage incident (subject: the instance)
an app paused for a storage incident was resumed (subject: the instance)
a live-state read failed; the last good data stays served as stale (subject: the topic; once per change into error)
a live-state read works again after a failure (subject: the topic)
a command that changes the system finished with exit 0 (hs dispatcher; subject: the words typed, never the arguments after them)
a command that changes the system failed (hs dispatcher; subject: the words typed, never the arguments after them)
a backup run finished without errors (subject: backup)
a backup run finished with errors (subject: backup)
the monthly restore-drill report was sent (subject: the push category; level warn when something is overdue or failed; payload: the number of problems)

hs update finished (a hs rebuild on its own is a job: see job.*)

a failed update was undone, the previous generation runs again
a failed update was not rolled back, the system was left as it is
a failed update could not be rolled back
the health check found a problem it did not know before (subject: the problem key; once per change, not per run)
a health problem is gone (subject: the problem key)
the mains power is out, the server runs on the UPS battery (subject: ups)
the mains power is back
the UPS battery is almost empty
the server shuts down because of the power failure (NUT FSD/SHUTDOWN or the battery deadline)
lost contact with the UPS
contact with the UPS is back
the UPS reports that its battery should be replaced
the server started with the vault open (subject: the host)
the server is going down (subject: reboot or poweroff)
encrypted storage is locked and waits for hs unlock (subject: storage; once per boot)
